brand.mission: To create calm and comforting spaces where we feel to heal.

about.headline: Guiding you home, one breath at a time
about.story: I'm a yoga instructor devoted to sharing practices that invite deep rest, self-inquiry, and sustainable transformation. Strings of Yoga is rooted in the understanding that we are all connected—through breath, awareness, and subtle inner threads that guide us home to ourselves.
about.philosophy: My teaching blends traditional yogic wisdom with modern nervous-system awareness, creating practices that are accessible, inclusive, and deeply nourishing. Whether you are new to yoga or a seasoned practitioner, you are welcome here exactly as you are.

heroSlides.title: Find your flow, one string at a time
heroSlides.description: Gentle Yog Nidra, breathwork, and restorative practices to calm your nervous system and reconnect with yourself.

heroSlides.title: A peaceful space to feel and heal
heroSlides.description: Workshops for anxiety, depression support, and mental wellness—held with warmth, not clinical distance.

quote.text: In the space between breaths, we remember who we are.
quote.author: Strings of Yoga
